# Advance Machinery Movers Sdn. Bhd.

> Advance Machinery Movers Sdn. Bhd. (441099-U, 先進機械搬運私人有限公司) is a machinery moving company in Taman Perindustrian Tampoi Jaya, Johor Bahru, incorporated in 1997, serving factories in Malaysia and Singapore.

- Company no.: 441099-U
- Chinese name: 先進機械搬運私人有限公司
- Signboard (Malay): SYARIKAT PEMINDAHAN DAN PEMBUNGKUSAN KEJENTERAAN
- Incorporated: 1997 in Johor Bahru (29 years in operation in 2026; 30th anniversary in 2027)
- Address: 14 & 20, Jalan Bayu 2/1, Taman Perindustrian Tampoi Jaya, 81200 Johor Bahru, Johor, Malaysia
- WhatsApp: +60 16-722 6779 (https://wa.me/60167226779), Wong Mei Wan, Assistant Manager
- Office: +60 7-236 9348
- Fax: +60 7-237 0422
- Email: advance.movers@yahoo.com (general), meiwan@advance-movers.com (Wong Mei Wan)
- Hours: Monday to Saturday 8:00am to 5:00pm; Sunday closed
- Service area: Malaysia and Singapore
- Google Maps: https://www.google.com/maps/place/?q=place_id:ChIJ0R6RyoJt2jERIApCbkJyBjY
- Waze: https://www.waze.com/live-map/directions/my/johor-darul-tazim/johor-bahru/advance-machinery-movers-sdn.-bhd.?to=place.ChIJ0R6RyoJt2jERIApCbkJyBjY
- Languages: English, Bahasa Melayu, 简体中文

## Services
- Rigging & Millwright Services: Moving, dismantling and installation of all types of machines. https://autoseo.my/preview/advance-machinery-movers/services/rigging-millwright/
- Plant Relocation: A whole line or plant, dismantled, moved and set up again. https://autoseo.my/preview/advance-machinery-movers/services/plant-relocation/
- Stuffing & Unstuffing Machines of the Container: Machines into and out of containers, safely and without damage. https://autoseo.my/preview/advance-machinery-movers/services/container-stuffing-unstuffing/
- Wooden Crates' Packing & Vacuum Packing: Custom wooden crates, normal pack or vacuum pack, for local and overseas shipments. https://autoseo.my/preview/advance-machinery-movers/services/wooden-crates-vacuum-packing/
- Precision Alignment: The last step of an install: machines set and aligned on the new floor. https://autoseo.my/preview/advance-machinery-movers/services/precision-alignment/
- Rental of Heavy Forklift & Side Loader: A 10-ton forklift and a side loader for rent at competitive prices. https://autoseo.my/preview/advance-machinery-movers/services/heavy-forklift-side-loader-rental/
